subject: Request: H100 reservation hold + commercial exceptions for Nebula Health
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Nebula — request for H100 reservation hold + custom overage/discount (URGENT)

Lauren —

Quick escalation: Nebula Health (Samira & Jordan) just confirmed they want to sign Dedicated for a 3-month initial commit but procurement needs a 4–6 week reservation hold while they finalize budget approvals. Key asks:

- Dedicated pool pinned to H100s (they benchmarked on H100 and want parity)
- Reservation hold: 6 weeks to avoid capacity being released
- Committed discount: 20% off list for the 3-month window
- Overage rate: 1.25x list during burst beyond committed baseline

They attached a capacity plan and a draft SOW (attached). Deal in HubSpot: HB-78934.

Risks: H100s are tight in the region; this hold would block capacity that might otherwise be sold. Nebula is a strategic AI health customer and likely to expand to yearly Reserved next quarter if we can secure the initial dedicated capacity.

Ask: Can we get executive sign-off on (a) granting a reservation hold for up to 6 weeks, (b) approving H100 device type for the Dedicated pool, and (c) an exception on overage rate / discount? If not full approval, what compromises would be acceptable (shorter hold, capped discount, conditional burst policy)?

I can jump on a quick call with finance/legal if helpful.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0124

ATTACHMENTS: nebula_capacity_plan_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), nebula_proposed_sof_draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula — request for H100 reservation hold + custom overage/discount (URGENT)

Dylan —

Thanks for the context and attachments. A few quick thoughts from deal-desk/ops perspective:

- H100-only reservation is a material allocation given current utilization in us-west. We can support H100s but need stronger commitment terms.
- Reservation hold makes sense for procurement alignments, but 6 weeks is longer than our standard 14-day hold.
- 20% discount on a short 3-month commit is high relative to our pricing bands; finance/legal will want guardrails.

Proposed counter (what I'd be comfortable escalating formally):
- Grant a 30-day reservation hold (extensible once if customer provides a written procurement timeline + PO within that extension).
- Approve H100-pin for the Dedicated pool for the initial 3-month term, with the condition that we monitor utilization and reserve right to convert to mixed GPU pool if utilization drops below 65% after 30 days.
- Cap discount at 15% for the committed baseline; allow an additional one-time marketing credit up to 5% tied to an expansion milestone (e.g., signed renewal to year).
- Overage rate: 1.5x list for burst beyond baseline for the first 90 days, review afterwards.

Marissa/legal: can you flag any SOW or procurement language we need (PO timelines, reservation hold clause, conversion rights)?

Vivek: can you weigh in on strategic value and whether we should waive any of these conditions?

- Lauren

--
Lauren Bishop
Head of Deal Desk, Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Jul 2026 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula — request for H100 reservation hold + custom overage/discount (URGENT)

Following up after quick sync with finance and ops. Executive decision (conditional):

- Approve H100 pin for the Dedicated pool for the initial 3-month term.
- Approve a reservation hold up to 30 days only. We will grant a single 14-day extension if Nebula supplies a written procurement timeline and signs the SOW by end of extension. No multi-stage holds.
- Discount: approve up to 15% on the committed baseline for the 3-month term. Any additional commercial concession must be tied to an explicit expansion milestone and recorded in HubSpot.
- Overage rate: set to 1.5x list for burst for the first 90 days. We will reassess after 90 days with utilization reports.
- Condition: PO or signed DocuSign SOW within 21 days of reservation start, otherwise we release capacity and may apply a re-commit fee if re-reservation is requested.

Operational asks to Dylan/ops:
- Mark the booking as "H100-pin (conditional)" in the capacity ledger and tag for utilization review at 30/90 days.
- Legal to insert reservation hold clause and the PO/timeline language into the SOW.

This preserves capacity discipline while enabling the customer to close. Dylan — communicate these terms to Nebula and get their written acceptance; escalate to me if they push for the 6-week hold or larger discount.

-Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Sales Strategy & GTM
Redwood Inference

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Patel <samira@nebulahealth.ai>, Jordan Liu <jordan.liu@nebulahealth.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Jul 2026 14:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Nebula — request for H100 reservation hold + custom overage/discount (NEXT STEPS)

Samira / Jordan —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our internal review, here are the approved, conditional terms we can proceed with:

- H100-pin for dedicated pool (initial 3-month term).
- Reservation hold: 30 days from the requested start date. We will allow one 14-day extension only if you provide a written procurement timeline and send a PO or sign the SOW during that extension.
- Committed baseline discount: 15% for the 3-month term. We can offer an additional one-time 5% marketing credit contingent on a signed renewal to an annual reserved contract.
- Overage (burst) rate: 1.5x list for burst beyond committed baseline for the first 90 days; we will review utilization and adjust thereafter.
- PO/Signed SOW: required within 21 days of reservation start or capacity will be released and a re-commit fee may apply.

Action items for Nebula: please review and confirm in writing by replying to this thread. I have attached the capacity plan and latest SOW draft for your review. Once you confirm, Marissa/legal will finalize the reservation hold language and we will send a DocuSign to sign.

If you need additional time, let me know immediately and we can surface a secondary path but it will require a stronger commercial commitment.

Cheers,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive — Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0124
